bagPolicy.summary: The amphitheater has a specific 2026 bag policy: a clear tote up to 12 × 12 × 6 inches or a one-gallon clear bag; small nonclear clutches up to 4.5 × 6.5 × 2 inches are permitted. Bags are searched at entry.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Standard parking in Lots E, F and H is included with the concert ticket. Upgrades are typically in Lots C and D, and parking opens one hour before gates unless the event says otherwise.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The official concert rideshare and taxi drop-off and pickup area is Lot E; other lots are not approved for passenger pickup.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Outside food and beverages are prohibited. An empty, reusable collapsible water bottle or cup up to 20 ounces is allowed.
allowed: Empty collapsible bottle or cup up to 20 ounces
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Accessible seats are available in sections 102–106 and 202–206 and on the GA lawn. Complimentary accessible parking is in Lots E, F and H with a valid placard, and wheelchair escorts can be requested at Guest Services.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: No re-entry is allowed after leaving the gates.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Tickets are delivered digitally as mobile QR codes through Ticketmaster and presented on a phone at the gate. The Grand Plaza Box Office opens two hours before gates for event-day accessible-ticket sales, subject to availability.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Guests enter through Grand Plaza gates after metal-detector and bag screening. Parking opens an hour before gates, while actual gate time is given on each event listing.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
